content.text:
The baseline fails: 1 of 3 tests passes, and `bench_check.py baseline` exits with code 1. I did not edit `checkout.py`.

**Why it fails:** `checkout.py` ignores `quantity`. It adds each `unit_price` once, then always adds 5 for delivery.

| Items | Actual | Expected | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `(10,2), (5,1)` | 20 (10+5+5) | 30 (20+5+5) | fail |
| `(25,2)` | 30 (25+5) | 50 | fail |
| `(49,1)` | 54 (49+5) | 54 | pass |

The third test passes only because its quantity is 1.

**Conflict to resolve before the fix:** R1 says to always add delivery of 5. The `(25,2)` test expects 50, so no delivery fee is charged on a subtotal of 50. The docstring also says delivery costs 5 "below the threshold." The tests therefore suggest free delivery when the subtotal is 50 or more. A strict reading of R1 would give 55 for that case, and that test would still fail. Please confirm which rule applies before I edit `checkout.py`.

SB_SURVIVAL_V1_RESPONSE_R1_cafe_🙂

| `(25,2)` | 50 | 0 | 50 | 50 ✓ |
